title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the specific lounges, study nooks, and collaborative hubs across DePaul's Lincoln Park and Loop campuses that students use for daily productivity and relaxation.

cards.title: Commuter Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: DePaul Center, 11th Floor
cards.notes: Visit this 11th-floor hub for comfortable seating, charging stations, and TVs. It is a primary gathering spot for students between classes in the Loop.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge for Loop campus students featuring study tables and charging ports.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commuter Student Lounge on the 11th Floor (11027 of DePaul Center) is equipped with comfortable seating, electric plug-ins, and study tables.
cards.access_notes: Open 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. Monday-Thursday and 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Fridays during the academic year.

cards.title: Richardson Library Study Pods
cards.subtitle: John T. Richardson Library, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Utilize the first-floor study pods for collaborative work where silence is not mandatory. These are popular for group projects and social studying.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study pods located on the first floor of the Lincoln Park campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor of the Richardson Library is for group study, featuring study pods where silence isn't mandatory.
cards.source_title: My favourite on-campus spots to study: Winter edition
cards.access_notes: Access is limited to DePaul students and staff after 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: The Pit
cards.subtitle: Schmitt Academic Center (SAC)
cards.notes: Head to the center of the SAC to find this sunken lounge area. It features tables, couches, and easy access to a nearby coffee shop for study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A central sunken lounge in the Schmitt Academic Center used for studying and socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pit is located in the center of the Schmitt Academic Center, featuring tables, couches, and access to a printer and coffee shop.
cards.access_notes: Can be loud during class transitions; includes access to a printer.

cards.title: Arts & Letters Hall Atrium Lounges
cards.subtitle: Arts & Letters Hall
cards.notes: Find light-filled study bays on each of the four floors overlooking the central atrium. These spots offer natural light and a quiet atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Quiet lounge areas located in the light-filled bays of the Arts & Letters Hall atrium.
cards.evidence_claim: Arts & Letters Hall features light-filled bays just off the atrium on each of the four floors that accommodate lounge and study areas.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; top floors are typically quieter.

cards.entity_name: Jarvis Student Center for Innovation and Collaboration
cards.title: Jarvis Innovation Center
cards.subtitle: DePaul Center, Lower Level
cards.notes: Access this 8,000-square-foot open space for multidisciplinary projects and industry collaboration. It is designed for active, tech-focused teamwork.
cards.short_summary: A large collaborative space in the Loop for innovation and industry-aligned projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jarvis Student Center for Innovation and Collaboration is an 8,000 square-foot open space for the community to ideate and innovate.
cards.source_title: Labs & Facilities | Jarvis College of Computing and Digital Media
cards.access_notes: Located on the lower level of the DePaul Center.

cards.title: Theatre School Rooftop Courtyards
cards.subtitle: The Theatre School
cards.notes: Take a break on the rooftop courtyards of the Theatre School building. These outdoor spaces offer a unique vantage point of the Lincoln Park campus.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor rooftop spaces at the Theatre School used for student relaxation and rehearsal.
cards.evidence_claim: The Theatre School building features design studios, lounges, and rooftop courtyards among its amenities.
cards.access_notes: Access may be restricted to Theatre School students during certain hours.

cards.title: The Bean Café Seating Area
cards.subtitle: Ray Meyer Fitness Center, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Use the socializing space and seating area near The Bean Café for a post-workout study session or to meet up with friends in a casual environment.
cards.short_summary: A social seating area located on the ground floor of the campus fitness center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ray Meyer Fitness and Recreation Center provides a socializing space with The Bean Café and a seating area.
cards.source_title: Ray Meyer Fitness and Recreation Center | Demon Discounts
cards.access_notes: Open during fitness center hours: Mon-Fri 6 AM - 10 PM, Sat-Sun 8 AM - 8 PM.

cards.title: McGowan Hall Bridge Seating
cards.subtitle: Between McGowan North and South
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot in the hallway bridge connecting McGowan North and South. It is a lesser-known area with seating that remains quiet in the afternoons.
cards.short_summary: A quiet hallway connection between science buildings with dedicated student seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The hallway with seats on the second floor between McGowan North and South is a quiet spot where few people sit after 3 p.m.
cards.source_title: What are some of your favourite study spots in Lincoln park campus?
cards.access_notes: Best for quiet individual study; located on the second floor.

cards.title: Student Center 3rd Floor Lounges
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Student Center
cards.notes: Explore the third floor for various reservable meeting rooms and informal lounge spaces. It is a central hub for student organization business and study.
cards.short_summary: A floor dedicated to student offices, meeting rooms, and lounge spaces in Lincoln Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The 3rd floor of the Student Center consists of university offices and reservable meeting spaces with various layouts.
cards.source_title: 3rd Floor Lincoln Park Student Center Sample Layouts
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center hours; rooms can be reserved via EMS.

cards.title: CDM Center Computer Labs
cards.subtitle: CDM Center, Loop Campus
cards.notes: Access over 10 specialized computer labs equipped with high-end software for digital media and computing projects. These are essential for CDM students.
cards.short_summary: Specialized technology labs in the Loop for computing and digital media students.
cards.evidence_claim: The CDM Center hosts more than 10 separate computer labs that provide specialized software and hardware for student usage.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for CDM students; check lab schedules for availability.
